steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const aircon = (s.items||[]).find(i => i.id === 'default-ld-aircon'); console.log('[probe] aircon', JSON.stringify(aircon && { id: aircon.id, pos: aircon.position.map(v=>+v.toFixed(3)), rot: +(aircon.rotation||0).toFixed(4), props: aircon.props })); const ld = (s.items||[]).find(i => i.id === 'default-ld-curtain'); console.log('[probe] living-curtain', JSON.stringify(ld && { id: ld.id, pos: ld.position.map(v=>+v.toFixed(3)), rot: +(ld.rotation||0).toFixed(4), props: ld.props })); const wins = (s.floorPlan.windows||[]).filter(w => /livingDining/.test(w.id)); console.log('[probe] living-window', JSON.stringify(wins)) })()
